title: [nightly/speed] Build each round's hole rows once for the milestones
summary: The dashboard answers about 30% faster (82 → 57 ms on 224 rounds) and /stats/milestones about 50% faster, because notable_achievements now builds each round's hole rows once instead of nine times. The output is byte-identical before and after.
stillOpen: Couldn't open the PR: the run had no GitHub access. Written against frontend-refactor before the redesign merge, so it needs porting onto factory/speed.
Conflicts with #587 in text only; a version on top of #587 is saved as claude/nightly-speed-2026-11-08-on-587.patch.
reviewFirst: _HoleRowsByRound is keyed by id(round); every round asked about comes from the same list.
The rows are shared and never written; anything that writes needs its own copy.
next: Make Course.get_hole a dict lookup, which speeds every endpoint that ranks or totals rounds.
Run the dashboard's four queries together.
